title: The *Specialist* Discount
dek: Amazon paid $7.5B to out-optimize Nvidia with software. OpenAI's GPT-6 designed proteins without a biology model. Each story today is the same substitution.

stories.label: of 322 candidates bound their target in lab tests
stories.headline: General reasoning is now a passable substitute for specialized biology models.
750B params, 28 layers run twice. No benchmarks. Efficiency claim is unproven at scale.
AI agents can now approve pull requests. Anthropic recommends starting in observe-only mode.
Cisco and OpenAI ship an agent that patches Linux vulns before humans do. Not production-ready.

stories.label: Amazon's reported price for Decart's chip optimization software
stories.headline: Amazon is betting software optimization can substitute for Nvidia's hardware superiority.

stories.short: UK FCA: AI agents trigger fin-reg
stories.headline: AI agents doing financial work trigger UK financial services law, whatever the company calls itself.

stories.label: of global annual revenue: Australia's penalty for tech non-compliance
stories.headline: At 5% of global revenue, the non-compliance cost can exceed the build-correctly cost.

stories.short: N. Korea AI on open-weight models
stories.headline: North Korea built a domestic AI chatbot. Likely on open weights. Sanctions did not stop it.

stories.short: XPeng AI Day: Iron robot demo
stories.headline: XPeng's humanoid Iron demos live today. Watch the gap between stage and production.

still_signal: Every specialist being replaced was also the accountable entity. The FCA named this for financial services. The other domains are still discovering what they had.
